verdict.rationale: Zoho Books' own features page says accountants can handle journal entries within the product, so the core capability exists. That is a single thin mention, with no documentation of how entries are created or posted. missing for 10: documented manual journal creation workflow, enforcement of balanced debits and credits, supporting memo/notes fields, a journal API endpoint reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can post manual journal entries with balanced debits, credits, and supporting memos

citations.quote: From handling journal entries and base currency adjustments to reconciliation and generating reports accountants can effortlessly manage your books from anywhere.
